_about: Scaffold-only, not installed. Which first-party file under .agents/ is based on which upstream file, at which commit, what we changed and why. kind: copy (runtime copy of a vendored file, D74), derived (our own rewrite based on upstream), pinned-addon (fetched or installed from upstream at a pin, not adapted). commit_basis: pinned (commit named in our file or PLAN record), blob-match (the vendored reference copy was byte-identical to upstream at this commit), release-tag (the upstream release we read), survey-date (read from the default branch; commit is the last one before the 2026-10-15 survey, so a diff from it may include changes already taken). To review upstream changes run scripts/upstream-diff.sh; accept or reject each change, apply accepted ones to path, then update upstream_commit (and sha256_of_upstream_at_copy for a copy), changes and reviewed_at. Checked by tests/lint/upstream-lineage.sh.
